data.name: Mufazzil
data.gender_notes: Mufazzil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mufazzil is an Arabic name derived from the root 'fazal' which means to help, to support and to assist. It signifies someone who is a chief helper, a main supporter and a strong advocate. The name Mufazzil carries the meaning “Chief Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mufazzil usually hope their child will grow to embody chief helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mufazzil embodies the qualities of a true servant of Allah, one who provides help and support to others while remaining steadfast in faith and devotion.
data.etymology: Mufazzil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chief Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufazzil total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مُفَضّيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُفَضّيل هو اللقب الذي ينسب إلى الصحابي الجليل، حيث أُطلق على بعض الصحابة لقب "المُفَضّيل" بسبب كرمهم وتواضعهم، ويُشير هذا اللقب إلى من أُطلق عليه لقب "المنصور المقدّم في الكِبَر والشَرَف"، حيث يُعدّ هذا اللقب مرتفعًا في الكرم والشرف، ويُشير إلى شخص يُعرف بمقدّمة الكِبَر والشَرَف والمنّة في حياته، ويُعتبر هذا اللقب من الأسماء النبوية التي أُطلقت على الصحابة، ويُستخدم في اللغة العربية للتعريف الشخصي.

in_urdu.name: مُفَضّیل
in_urdu.meaning: کرم سے بھرپور اور بڑھاپے اور شرف میں سبقت والے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُفَضّیل ایک لطیف لقب ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ نے کسی صحابی کی طرف سے استعمال کیا ہے، جس نے اسے "منصور المقدم فی الکبر و الشرف" کے لقب کے لیے منتخب کیا ہے، یہ لقب کرم اور شرف میں بڑھتے ہوئے شخص کی علامت ہے، جو بڑھاپے اور شرف میں سبقت کرتا ہے، اور جس کی زندگی میں مننا اور کرم کا نشان ہوتا ہے، یہ لقب اسلامی روایات میں ایک اعزاز ہے، اور ہم اسے اپنے بچوں کے نام دینے کے لیے استعمال کرتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुफ़़्ज़्ज़ील
in_hindi.meaning: समृद्धि से भरा हुआ और बुढ़ापे और सम्मान में आगे
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुफ़़्ज़्ज़ील एक सुंदर उपाधि है जो अल्लाह ने एक साथी के लिए उपयोग किया है, जिसे "मनसूर मुकद्दम फ़ी अलक़बर व अशशरफ़" के उपाधि के लिए चुना गया है, यह उपाधि क़ुरआन में एक उच्च आदर का प्रतीक है, जो बुढ़ापे और सम्मान में आगे बढ़ता है, और जिसके जीवन में मुन्नत और क़ुदरत का प्रदर्शन होता है, यह उपाधि इस्लामी परम्पराओं में एक सम्मान है, और हम इसे अपने बच्चों के नाम देने के लिए उपयोग करते हैं

in_pashto.name: مُفَضّیل
in_pashto.meaning: نیکوکار و بړه کړی او زده
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُفَضّیل یوځای لقب دی چې الله تعالی ننه یوځای صحابي ته استعمال کړی دی، چې په «منصور المقدم فی الکبر و الشرف» لقب ته منتخب کړی دی، دا لقب کرم او زده کړنې ته اشاره کوي، چې کړنې ته بړه کړي او زده کړي، او چې د ژوند کړنې ته مننا او کرم کړي، دا لقب اسلامي روايات کړي دا لوړه نوم دی، او ښاغلی یوځای په خپلو بچو کړو نومو ته استعمال کړی دی

in_english.name: Mufazzil
in_english.meaning: Blessed and advanced in age and nobility
in_english.long_meaning: Mufazzil is a title of nobility given to a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, as mentioned in the Quran. It is derived from the Arabic root word "fazzala", which means to elevate or exalt. The title Mufazzil refers to one who is blessed and advanced in age and nobility, possessing great power and spiritual strength. In Islamic tradition, Mufazzil is considered a sign of excellence and a symbol of spiritual growth. The name Mufazzil is often given to children in Muslim families as a way of instilling values of nobility and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mufazzil carries a sense of responsibility and strength. In Islamic culture, the name signifies someone who is always there to lend a helping hand, to support and to uplift others, especially during times of need. It reflects the values of compassion, generosity and the importance of community support in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mufazzil signifies one who is steadfast in their faith and assists others in their spiritual journey. It suggests a person who is deeply committed to their beliefs and is working towards spiritual growth and enlightenment by helping others. The name reflects the Islamic principle of Tawhid or the oneness of God, as it emphasizes the importance of supporting and uplifting fellow human beings as a reflection of God's love and care for His creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Mufazzil in Arabic means "reciter of the Quran". This name signifies the individual's dedication to the memorization and recitation of the sacred verses, deepening their connection with God and increasing their spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mufazzil ibn Ubayd al-Juhani was a renowned scholar and poet of the 8th century. The name Mufazzil carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mufazzil was a prominent figure in the Islamic world during the early Abbasid period. He was known for his scholarship in various fields, including poetry, jurisprudence, and theology. His works were highly regarded by scholars of his time and have influenced Islamic thought to this day.
